name: Kisnémedi (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kisnémedi: a blue shield with a bunch of grapes, within a wreath of grapevine, with a red scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisnémedi arms with vine wreath and scroll
